title: Open spaces and risk perception in post-earthquake Kathmandu city

contacts.name: M Th  Koelen
contacts.affiliation: Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation

descriptions: The research investigates the relationship between built environment, in particular open spaces, and perception of seismic risk of people. The research uses both quantitative and qualitative methods to analyse this relationship. The comparative case study of two earthquake hit communities in Kathmandu after the 2015 earthquake was done and is the basis for this data.
